name: Doki Doki Meme Club! Part 2: Rise of the Dark Memes
source:
The adventure of the Meme Club continues. But this time, they're danker than ever. If you've gotten sick of the endless assault of Natsuki-routes and Save Them All stories, then Meme Club 2 is the mod for you.
[Based from [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/meme-club-2/]DokiMods[/url]]
